name: WPC B2B & Wholesale for WooCommerce
author: WPClever

sections.description:
WPC B2B & Wholesale is a robust, all-in-one plugin designed to transform your standard WooCommerce store into a powerful B2B wholesale platform. Simplify your workflow by replacing multiple scattered plugins with one highly optimized suite that covers role management, dynamic dynamic pricing, VAT exemptions, limit enforcement, and financial credit tracking.

Key Features

  • Robust Role Management: Seamlessly create unlimited custom B2B roles (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold). Keep your hierarchy organized with an intuitive drag-and-drop interface, determining the priority of role-based rules.
  • Dynamic Catalog Mode: Protect your profit margins and sensitive B2B pricing by hiding prices and the “Add to Cart” buttons from unauthorized or non-logged-in guest users.
  • Wholesale Registration & Approvals: Create a wholesale application endpoint inside the standard WooCommerce My Account page. Admins can review attachments safely and approve, reject, or assign custom roles to candidates from a dedicated CRM-style backend table.
  • Tax Exemption: Automatically strip away VAT or taxes based on valid VAT ID.
  • Quantity Limits: Enforce volume buying via MOQ & MPQ metrics.
  • B2B Purchase Orders: Revolutionary Net-30 tracking and custom credit limits.

Need more features?

  • WPC Price by Quantity for WooCommerce
  • WPC Price by User Role for WooCommerce
  • WPC Product Options for WooCommerce
  • WPC AJAX Add to Cart for WooCommerce
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wpc-b2b-wholesale directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. A default ‘Wholesaler’ role is injected automatically on activation.
  4. Navigate to B2B & Wholesale in the admin menu to manage configurations.
